name: 1-1:Planet Ragol
short:
Go down to
Ragol's surface
and report on
the conditions
there.

name: 1-2:Torrential Woods
short:
Eliminate the
hostile animals
prowling around
the Central
Dome area!

name: 1-3:Subterranean Den
short:
Nobody has
come back from
beneath
the Central
Dome alive...

name: 2-1:Infernal Cavern
short:
A cave has been
found beneath
Ragol. Go and
investigate.

name: 2-2:Deep Within
short:
A bizarre
monument,
has been found
within the
caverns…

name: 2-3:The Mutation
short:
Gather data on
the creatures
that live
underground.

name: 2-4:Waterway Shadow
short:
Mysterious
"thing" seen
in the
underground
waterway.

name: 3-1:The Facility
short:
Why is there a
large-scale
facility
underneath
Ragol?

name: 3-2:Machines Attack
short:
Annihilate the
machines that
are down in
the mines!

name: 3-3:Central Control
short:
Find the
control room
to the
underground
facility!

name: 4-1:The Lost Ruins
short:
Break the
seal to the
ruins and
get inside!

name: 4-2:Buried Relics
short:
Get data on
the writing
from the
stone monument
in the ruins!

name: 4-3:Hero & Daughter
short:
A secret
request from
the Principal.
What could
he want?

name: 4-4:The Tomb Stirs
short:
Exterminate the
enemies and
secure a path
through the
ruins!

name: 4-5:Dark Inheritance
short:
Get to the
bottom of
the ruins!
The answers
must lie there!
